Leading Denim Manufacturer
Founded in 1986 by Dr Yamunadutt Agrawal, Jindal Worldwide Ltd is a diversified and integrated textile fabric and shirting manufacturer and is Asia’s largest fully integrated manufacturer of denim fabric. JWL is the flagship company of the Ahmedabad-based Jindal Group.
